Class RestPkiCertificateAuthenticator

Namespace
NuvTools.Security.Certificate.Lacuna
Assembly
NuvTools.Security.Certificate.Lacuna.dll

Authenticates a certificate through Lacuna REST PKI. The client signs the challenge in the browser with Web PKI (signWithRestPki); the service validates possession of the private key and the trust chain, and the subject is read from the certificate it validated.
